title: Boundary behaviour of eigenfunctions and superharmonic functions on harmonic manifolds of purely exponential volume growth
summary: On $\mathbb{X}$, a non-positively curved harmonic manifold of purely exponential volume growth, of dimension $n \ge 3$, we study certain quantitative aspects of the boundary behaviour of eigenfunctions and superharmonic functions. We first focus on complex-valued eigenfunctions lying outside the $L^2$-spectrum of $Δ$ and obtain the almost everywhere existence of weighted non-tangential limits, sharp Hausdorff dimension and Hausdorff measure estimates of the boundary exceptional sets for radial limits.
